description: RESET frame (code=1 PROTOCOL_ERROR) whose message contains an embedded NUL byte. OVERVIEW.md section 2.3: message 'SHOULD be <= 256B, no NUL' is a SHOULD, not a wire-format MUST -- the 8-byte-header + code + bytes frame decodes successfully at the wire level (NUL is valid UTF-8) regardless. The NUL-freedom check is SDK unit-test territory: a per-SDK RESET-sending helper SHOULD reject or strip an embedded NUL before it ever reaches the wire, but that policy lives above the frame decoder this checker implements, not in it.
policy_violation: message contains a NUL byte; SHOULD-level violation only, see description
